newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Police sound final whistle on skull kick-about.
newsitem.headline: Police sound final whistle on skull kick-about.

text.p: A children's street game of soccer was cut short after police in Ghent, west of Brussels, confiscated the round object being kicked about -a human skull over 100 years old, the Belga agency said on Wednesday.
Police were alerted by a passer-by who saw the children playing with the skull, probably unearthed from a disused cemetery during roadworks.
